title: Nourishing Smoky Filipino Duck Confit
description: A smoky and pillowy Filipino dish featuring duck, served in a scallop shell, perfect for a romantic evening, this plant-based friendly recipe uses tofu instead of traditional duck.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, filipino vinegar, coconut oil, garlic, ginger, salt, black pepper, and chili flakes.
Add the tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the smoky mixture.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the tofu from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Spoon the tofu mixture into the scallop shells, leaving a small border around the edges.
Place the scallop shells on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the scallop shells from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the smoky tofu confit in the scallop shells, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
